text.heading: API reference
text.subheading: Every documented route module, generated from the API itself - so what you read here is what the server enforces.
text.group_required_hint: Every endpoint expects an Authorization: Bearer header and the matching permission.
text.auth_note: Endpoints still check the caller's permission for this entity - being able to read the documentation is not being able to call them.
text.cors_note: Browser calls are limited to allow-listed origins. A request carrying an Origin the API does not know is refused with 403 before it reaches the endpoint, whether or not it has a token - so an open endpoint is not one any page on the web can call. Server-to-server calls send no Origin and are unaffected.
text.unavailable: The API reference is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
